description: Defines a thread-safe, singleton template class for managing fixed-size memory blocks with thread-local caching and a central cache, including methods for allocation, deallocation, and cache management.

classes.name: fixed_size_memory_block_pool
classes.description: A thread-safe singleton template class managing a pool of fixed-size memory blocks with thread-local caches and a central cache.

methods.name: get_instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the memory pool, optionally initializing with specific parameters.

methods.name: allocate_node
methods.description: Allocates a memory block of the maximum size or specified size from the pool.

methods.name: deallocate_node
methods.description: Returns a memory block back to the pool.

methods.name: print_all_buffers
methods.description: Prints the current state of the central and local caches.

methods.name: get_central_cache_approx_size
methods.description: Returns an approximate size of the central cache in number of memory blocks.

methods.name: get_local_cache_size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the thread-local cache in number of memory blocks.

methods.name: owns_segment
methods.description: Checks if a given memory segment belongs to this pool.

methods.name: init_worker_cache
methods.description: Initializes the thread-local cache for the calling thread.
